rows.name: format-receipt-100
rows.source: set rows {};for {set i 0} {$i<100} {incr i} {lappend rows [format {%04d|%8.2f|%-8s} $i [expr {$i*1.375}] apple]};lindex $rows end

rows.name: scan-record-100
rows.source: set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<100} {incr i} {scan {0042|13.75|ready} {%d|%f|%s} id amount status;incr total $id};list $total $amount $status

rows.name: format-exact-100
rows.source: set text {};for {set i 0} {$i<100} {incr i} {set text [format {%.80f} 0.1]};set text

scope: Three small warm-session workloads, native and Node measured separately on one host; exact results verified. Different host adapters; no full application, peak memory or cross-platform acceptance.
